detail:
Decisions: Chose to make no source change for the rationale_source drop and to report the premise as false instead — reason: an end-to-end probe of the current build persists the field correctly, so every candidate 'fix' would have been a no-op edit to correct code, and shipping one would have masked the real cause while appearing to resolve it. Rejected alternative: patch the forwarding in decisions.ts or record-tools.ts defensively anyway, reason_rejected: both already forward the field, and a redundant guard would make the next stale-process incident harder to recognise, not easier.
Findings: CORRECTS warning 01KZ7G5HTEKDNAJA2KD9RFESKG, which claimed rationale_source was 'lost somewhere between parseDecision and the persisted record'. That is WRONG. There is no code defect. End-to-end probe against the current build — fresh `node dist/index.js --project <tmp>` process, real stdio MCP twining_record call with an authored rationale — persists rationale_source:'authored' correctly. Source and dist are both complete; the chain works.; ROOT CAUSE: the MCP server serving this session is a long-lived process started Tue 09:00 (ps shows `npm exec twining-mcp@^2.0.0` -> /opt/homebrew/bin/twining-mcp, which readlink resolves to /Users/dave/code/twining-mcp/dist/index.js — the global npm install is a symlink into this working repo). dist/engine/decisions.js, dist/tools/record-tools.js and dist/engine/record-parser.js were all rebuilt Aug 4 12:30, AFTER that process launched. Node holds modules in memory, so the running server serves pre-rebuild code. Restarting the server (a new session) is the entire fix.; warning: this failure mode is silent and structural, not a one-off. Because the global twining-mcp bin is npm-linked to this repo's dist/, every rebuild makes already-running servers stale, and nothing surfaces which build a server is actually running. Any behaviour observed through a long-lived session may reflect code from an arbitrary earlier point. Diagnose with `ps` + readlink + dist mtimes before concluding a code defect — I spent a full investigation cycle concluding a bug that did not exist.; Suggested hardening, NOT implemented: have the server report its build identity (package version plus dist build timestamp or git sha) via twining_status or the startup banner, so a stale process is detectable rather than inferred from mtimes. Cheap, and it would have turned this investigation into a single call.; Do NOT backfill rationale_source onto the 456 existing records. Their provenance is genuinely unknown — stamping them 'authored' would fabricate the exact signal the field exists to make trustworthy. The content scorer's treatment (absent marker = unknown, capped at 0.5 partial credit) is the honest handling and should stay.
summary: Disproved my own rationale_source warning: source and build are both correct. The marker is missing because the running server process predates the Aug 4 12:30 rebuild and serves stale in-memory code.
